title: SoulFactory agent customization draft schema foundation
scope: Epic 1 Task 1.1: additive domain model support for v2 SoulFactory draft customization specs.
intended_behavior: Soul draft content can explicitly declare schema soulfactory-draft/v2.
Soul draft content can carry portable persona, avatar, voice, and memory nested specs.
Legacy v1 draft fields remain parseable and can be migrated additively into v2 without dropping the legacy fields.
Spec hash computation observes the new customization fields through draft JSON serialization.
out_of_scope: Event codec merge semantics and provider/model validation.
Web client v2 builders and editors.
